WITH station_config AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (VALUES
    ('l1_buffer_a',   'buffer_idle_time',                       'buffer_holding_time',                          'buffer_pallet_release_time'),
    ('l1_buffer_b',   'buffer_idle_time',                       'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time',     'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'),
    ('l2_buffer_a',   'buffer_idle_time',                       'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time',     'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'),
    ('l2_buffer_b',   'buffer_idle_time',                       'buffer_holding_and_pre_stopper_down_time',     'buffer_pallet_release_and_pre_stopper_up_time'),
    ('shuttle_station','shuttle_idle_time',                     'shuttle_pre_scan_time',                        'shuttle_stopper_rising_time'),
    ('l1_dispenser',  'dispenser_entry_unclamp_time',           'dispenser_entry_unclamp_time',                 'dispenser_stopper_rasing'),
    ('l2_dispenser',  'dispenser_entry_unclamp_time',           'dispenser_entry_unclamp_time',                 'dispenser_stopper_rasing'),
    ('l1_inspection', 'inspection_idle_time',                   'inspection_lifter_rising_time',                'inspection_pallet_releasing_time'),
    ('l2_inspection', 'inspection_idle_time',                   'inspection_lifter_rising_time',                'inspection_pallet_releasing_time')
  ) AS t(station_name, idle_metric, start_metric, end_metric)
  WHERE station_name = '${station_name}'
),

idle_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics pm
  JOIN station_config sc ON pm.station_name = sc.station_name
  WHERE pm.metric_name = sc.idle_metric
),

pre_starts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics pm
  JOIN station_config sc ON pm.station_name = sc.station_name
  WHERE pm.metric_name = sc.start_metric
),

starts AS (
  SELECT start_time FROM idle_starts
  UNION
  SELECT p.start_time FROM pre_starts p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM idle_starts i
    WHERE i.start_time BETWEEN p.start_time - INTERVAL '10 seconds'
                           AND p.start_time + INTERVAL '10 seconds'
  )
),

ends AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.timestamp AS end_time
  FROM process_metrics pm
  JOIN station_config sc ON pm.station_name = sc.station_name
  WHERE pm.metric_name = sc.end_metric
),

cycle_pair AS (
  SELECT
    s.start_time,
    MIN(e.end_time) AS end_time
  FROM starts s
  JOIN ends e ON e.end_time > s.start_time
  WHERE s.start_time BETWEEN
        to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
    AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '30 seconds'
  GROUP BY s.start_time
),

metric_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.metric_name, p.timestamp)
         p.metric_name,
         p.value,
         p.unit,
         p.timestamp
  FROM cycle_pair cp
  JOIN process_metrics p
    ON p.timestamp >= cp.start_time
   AND p.timestamp <= cp.end_time
   AND p.station_name = '${station_name}'
  ORDER BY p.metric_name, p.timestamp
)

SELECT *
FROM metric_data
ORDER BY timestamp;
